ideas.name: Pixel Pet
ideas.summary: A tiny dot-matrix pet that lives on your screen. Feed it, play with it and watch it grow.

ideas.name: Lo-fi Clock
ideas.summary: A calm dot-matrix desk clock with alarms and a gentle night mode.

ideas.name: Photo Frame
ideas.summary: Shows a slideshow of photos you send from your phone over Wi-Fi.

ideas.name: Pomodoro
ideas.summary: A focus timer with 25-minute sessions, short breaks and a daily streak.

ideas.name: Emoji Face
ideas.summary: Turns the screen into an expressive face that reacts to sound and touch.

ideas.name: Voice Notes
ideas.summary: Record short voice memos and play them back any time.

ideas.name: Music Box
ideas.summary: Plays relaxing tunes and white noise through the built-in speaker.

ideas.name: Rhythm Pad
ideas.summary: Tap the screen to play drums and loops, then record your beat.

ideas.name: Weather Station
ideas.summary: Live weather for your city: temperature, rain and a 3-day forecast.

ideas.name: Home Remote
ideas.summary: Control smart lights and plugs on your home network from one screen.

ideas.name: Plant Buddy
ideas.summary: Reminds you to water your plants and logs soil moisture from a sensor.

ideas.name: Air Monitor
ideas.summary: Shows temperature, humidity and air quality from an attached sensor.

ideas.name: Light Meter
ideas.summary: Measures ambient light with an attached sensor and charts it over the day.

ideas.name: Sound Meter
ideas.summary: Measures noise with the microphone and warns you when it gets loud.

ideas.name: AI Chat
ideas.summary: Talk to an AI assistant and read its answers on screen.

ideas.name: Morse Chat
ideas.summary: Send and receive Morse code messages with friends over Wi-Fi.

ideas.name: Walkie Talkie
ideas.summary: Push-to-talk voice messages between Mosaico devices on the same network.

ideas.name: Servo Lab
ideas.summary: Drive up to four hobby servos with sliders and save your favorite poses.

ideas.name: Robot Car
ideas.summary: Remote-control a two-motor robot car with on-screen arrows.

ideas.name: Fan Control
ideas.summary: Speed control for a DC fan, with an automatic mode based on temperature.

store_only.name: Retro Snake
store_only.summary: The classic snake game with dot-matrix graphics and a high-score table.

store_only.name: Dice Roller
store_only.summary: Roll up to six dice with a shake animation. Great for board games.
